diagnosis: ser_tx stayed idle so loopback RX got 0xff vs want 0xa5, causing TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xff want 0xa5 and tohost FAIL 0xdead. Root cause is picosoc/simpleuart.v:130 `send_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)` which makes the TX bit period 16x too short for divider 64, so the receiver samples idle and returns 0xff.
